Interface VirtualViewRmi

All Superinterfaces:
Remote, VirtualView
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClient
public interface VirtualViewRmi extends Remote, VirtualView
RMI specialisation of VirtualView. Extends Remote and narrows all throws clauses to RemoteException as required by the RMI protocol. This is the remote object on which the server performs callbacks to each client.
